audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4, 5 and 6 read Tryndamere, Ornn, Ornn — level 6 given to Tryndamere and both item rows to Ornn, the opposite of how the lane actually resolves.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror set level 6 to Ornn, first item to Skill and 2+ items to Tryndamere. Call of the Forge God is a 2500-range, 140/120/100s ultimate that makes you Brittle and knocks you up on recast — level 6 is his. By two items the fight that matters is a side lane duel, where his ultimate contributes least.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Tryndamere with ratings 7,4,4,4,4,5,6, in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere for the abilities the page tells you to track, and 'Volcanic Rumble' was used for the Q.
audit.why: The real name is Volcanic Rupture (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 800 range). Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s at 450 range — the actual window you trade into. Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: Correct name and the three cooldowns written into spikes[0], spikes[1] and the level-6 and first-item phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page described 'E Searing Charge knock-up into a Q Brittle detonation' — it attributed Brittle to the Q and treated the knock-up as automatic.
audit.why: Riot's text: Volcanic Rupture damages, slows and leaves a magma pillar — no Brittle. Brittle comes from the final gout of Bellows Breath (W) and from the ultimate. Searing Charge only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain while charging, which is exactly why his own Q pillar and any wall are the trap. Standing away from walls removes the knock-up entirely.
audit.corrected: The combo rewritten around the terrain condition and Brittle moved to Bellows Breath in spikes[0], mid and dontsFull[1].

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God arrives at 2500 range on 140/120/100s, makes you Brittle and knocks you up on his recast — Undying Rage survives it, but it still decides the fight.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Volcanic Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker is your spike, but Brittle answers it — force fights only once Searing Charge is spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: the side lane is yours, and it is where his ultimate does least. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close it out there.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bellows Breath applies Brittle — his next hit then lands far harder.

edits.before: At 6 your R survives his combo and lets you turn the fight.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Call of the Forge God lands from 2500 range.

edits.before: Your first crit item lets you out-DPS a pure-tank Ornn.
edits.after: First item evens it — your crit against his Brittle burst.

edits.before: By 2+ items Ornn's scaling teamfight R and tankiness make it even again.
edits.after: By 2+ items you out-duel him in a side lane, where his R does least.

edits.before: Ornn's power spike is level 4 with both Q Volcanic Rumble and E Searing Charge up: his E dash can knock you up into a Q Brittle detonation for a big chunk, so respect the E range and don't stand in his Q flame pillar. Farm at range, dodge the E charge, and only trade when his abilities are down since his tank stats mean you lose short auto exchanges into his cooldowns.
edits.after: Ornn's spike is level 4 with Volcanic Rupture (Q) and Searing Charge (E) up: Q leaves a magma pillar, and E only knocks up when he collides with terrain — so his own pillar, and every wall, is the trap. Brittle comes from Bellows Breath (W), and it makes his follow-up hit land far harder. Stay off walls, and trade only while Searing Charge sits on its 14-12s cooldown.

edits.before: Your R Undying Rage beats his single-target burst — bait his E Searing Charge and Q Brittle combo, survive it with R if needed, then Q Bloodlust the crit heal and turn. He has no execute, so once you have your ult his combo just sets up a fight you win.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God travels 2500 range on 140/120/100s, applies Brittle and knocks you up on his recast — Undying Rage survives it but does not stop it. Bait the W-E first, hold R for the ultimate rather than for chip, and Bloodlust back to full as your window closes.

edits.before: Levels 2-3 are a skill test, then level 4 tilts to Ornn: with Q and E up his E Searing Charge knock-up into a Q Brittle detonation is a real burst, so dodge the dash and only trade into his cooldowns.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are a skill test, then 4 tilts to Ornn: Volcanic Rupture drops a pillar and Searing Charge knocks you up only when it strikes terrain, so never fight beside that pillar or a wall — trade into his cooldowns instead.

edits.before: From 6 and your first crit item you take over — R Undying Rage survives his combo and your crits out-DPS a pure-tank Ornn — but by full items his teamfight R and upgraded tankiness make grouped fights his, so split and only duel him when your ult is up.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Call of the Forge God reaches 2500 range, applies Brittle and knocks up on recast — but by two items you own the side lane, where his ultimate does least and your crit out-DPSes a pure-tank build. Duel him away from walls, with R banked.

edits.before: Land E-into-Q Brittle detonation at level 4
edits.after: Charge into his own pillar for the knock-up

notes: The packet reports games 1266 at the top level and 1077 inside the packet block for the same matchup — worth someone checking which figure the page renders. Kit flag noted, not asserted: Volcanic Rupture (Q) carries a 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes' flag, but Riot's text gives only damage, a slow and the pillar. If that grounding is real it would deny Spinning Slash as an escape from the pillar setup, which changes how you disengage — listed in unverified rather than written into the page.
